headline: Knee-high SSE dribble, glassy at dawn then cross-on — log it early or wait for midweek.
today: Small stuff, 1-1.5ft of short-period SSE, but the dawn window is glassy with light N and cross-off before it backs SE cross-on by afternoon. Get on it early around the outgoing tide off the 10:29 high if you go at all. Longboard only, this is a cruise-and-catch-anything session, not a performance day.

daysToWatch.note: SE swell fills to head-high-ish with a longer 8-9s pulse and total to 3.4ft. Dawn 10mph NE is your cleanest window before E cross wind ramps to 15 through the day. Fish or shortboard early.
The one to flag: 2.6-3.2ft ESE at a prime angle, total near 4ft, with NNE cross-off in the morning. Dawn to mid-morning before the tide drains and wind swings SE. Home break earns its keep here.
